title: Compile a positive all-input relative reaction-event kernel by quadrature
statement: The source's exponentially weighted midpoint rule constructs a positive product-operator sum G with exp(-rho h/2) G <= K_t <= exp(rho h/2) G entrywise. It gives a relative rather than absolute certificate, uniform across every supported input law. The sharper Gauss route requires a separate derivative/numerical spread certificate.
